entries.subject: Varus
entries.context: This patch we did work to adjust Varus' top and bottom power skew, which involved shifting the balance between his Q and W for laning. While the resulting changes have seemed promising, we unfortunately added a major bug to his Q during this work, causing it to no longer deal reduced damage to subsequent targets. We are fixing that bug, and compensating with a buff.

changes.text: Passive Bonus AD and AP on Kill/Takedown: (1.1 per 10% AS) as bonus AD and AP ⇒ 1.4 per 10% AS
changes.label: Passive Bonus AD and AP on Kill/Takedown
changes.before: (1.1 per 10% AS) as bonus AD and AP

entries.subject: Azir
entries.context: We've kept the Emperor of the Sands’ mana pool pretty dry to make sure he needs to use soldier attacks properly for lane control early instead of just spamming [Q] Conquering Sands, but this is overly restrictive now that there are strong rank up incentives on his [W] Arise! We’re buffing his Mana Growth so he can more freely use his abilities to contest lane.

entries.subject: Caitlyn
entries.context: Caitlyn’s been at a very high pick and ban rate for most players for months now despite adjustments to other marksmen and the bot meta, so it's time to nerf her. We have felt that her late-game scaling has been too strong for a while now, so we’re moving some of her power from her eyepopping full build headshots into her early game Q damage to rebalance her power curve.

changes.text: Damage: 60 - 100% AD (+1% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+1% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage) ⇒ 60 - 80% AD (+0.8% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+0.8% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)
changes.label: Damage
changes.before: 60 - 100% AD (+1% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+1% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)
changes.after: 60 - 80% AD (+0.8% AD per 1% per Crit Chance) (+0.8% AD per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)

entries.subject: Darius
entries.context: Darius has moved a bit too far away from being a persistently durable damage threat that needs to be kited to more of a one shot combo playstyle. Since he has some room for power, we’re giving him a slight boost so he can swing that axe more often in sustained fights.

entries.subject: Jinx
entries.context: Like her best friend Caitlyn, Jinx has been similarly dominant in the meta, even with the Hurricane nerf last patch. We’re slowing her roll to make it a tad harder to get her snowballing.

entries.subject: Lee Sin
entries.context: Lee Sin has continued to be extremely popular since his adjustments to how his [W] Safeguard cooldown works with allies. While we like the extra flexibility that has given him, it's a bit too much power, so we’re nerfing the cooldown a bit along with a minor bug fix to how his E reveal works against invisible enemies and another small nerf to his [R] Dragon's Rage damage.

changes.text: Bugfix: No longer reveals invisible enemies if they stealth after being hit by Tempest.
changes.label: Bugfix
changes.value: No longer reveals invisible enemies if they stealth after being hit by Tempest.

changes.text: Collision Damage: 175 / 400 / 625 (+200% bonus AD) (+12 / 15 / 18% Kicked Champion's Health) ⇒ 150 / 350 / 550 (+200% bonus AD) (+12 / 15 / 18% Kicked Champion's Health)
changes.label: Collision Damage

entries.subject: Locke
entries.context: Locke’s been out for long enough now that we have a better picture of where he’s overly excelling and where he’s falling a bit short. Some of those areas are his extremely generous mana tuning and ability to shrug off harass, and we’re also refining his power curve by improving his scaling damage slightly, because he falls off a bit too fast if he’s not able to close out games early.

changes.text: Unused Charge Refund: 20 - 35% mana and cooldown refund ⇒ 10 - 40% mana and cooldown refund
changes.label: Unused Charge Refund

changes.text: Grey Health Store Based on Current Health: 40 - 200 (both level based) ⇒ 20 - 200
changes.label: Grey Health Store Based on Current Health

changes.text: Current Health Store: 150 - 450 (both level based) ⇒ 100 - 500 (+60% AP)
changes.label: Current Health Store

entries.subject: Miss Fortune
entries.context: Miss Fortune has been in a relatively decent place throughout the year, but with the Hubris nerf this patch, we’re looking to compensate with a couple buffs to her damage output.

changes.text: Critical Strike Damage: 130% (+0.3% per 1% Bonus Crit Damage) ⇒ 145% (+0.45% per 1% Bonus Crit Damage)
changes.label: Critical Strike Damage

entries.subject: Nidalee
entries.context: Our favorite huntress has been sitting at an extremely high winrate in high skill brackets, toeing the line into overpowered territory for some time now, even if she's not currently meta. Now that we’re bringing down the power of some other powerful meta junglers like Lee Sin, we’re giving Nidalee a minor nerf to prevent her from getting out of paw.

entries.subject: Nunu & Willump
entries.context: The boy and his yeti lost some power when we nerfed Hextech Rocketbelt earlier this year so that ranged mages weren't just buying it for a dash to safety, so we’re restoring some of that damage elsewhere.

entries.subject: Orianna
entries.context: We’re tapping up Orianna’s scalings to help her chunk a bit harder with her bread-and-butter combo in the late game without giving too much additional power to her laning phase.

entries.subject: Qiyana
entries.context: Damage on Qiyana's Q turned out to be a lot more impactful than we anticipated, so we’re partially reverting the buff we gave her back in 26.17.

groups.title: Q - Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal

entries.subject: Rammus
entries.context: While Nidalee's winrate has been borderline overpowered in the high skill levels, Rammus has been rolling over pretty much everyone else, so he’s getting a light nerf too, ok?

changes.text: Bonus Magic Resistance: 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+30 - 60% Magic Resistance) ⇒ 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+30 - 50% Magic Resistance)
changes.label: Bonus Magic Resistance

entries.subject: Ryze
entries.context: After the significantly early game nerfs to Ryze in 26.19, he hasn't been rewarded enough for succeeding when he does scale, so we’re buffing that.

changes.text: Flux Bonus Damage: 15% / 40% / 65% / 90% increased damage ⇒ 10% / 40% / 70% / 100% increased damage
changes.label: Flux Bonus Damage

entries.subject: Sion
entries.context: Our favorite unstoppable juggernaut is looking rather stoppable in recent patches. We’re giving him some buffs to his baseline durability and rewarding him when he succeeds at using his ult to GET IN THERE rather than run away.

changes.text: Damage Increase over the First 3s of Channeling: +0 - 166.67% Base Damage, 0 - 100% Ratio Damage ⇒ +0 - 200%
changes.label: Damage Increase over the First 3s of Channeling

changes.text: Bugfix: Tooltip now displays the correct minimum and maximum bonus AD ratios (40-120%). It displayed an incorrect Bonus AD Scaling (60%-120%). It was never actually changed in patch 25.16 beyond the tooltip.
changes.label: Bugfix
changes.value: Tooltip now displays the correct minimum and maximum bonus AD ratios (40-120%). It displayed an incorrect Bonus AD Scaling (60%-120%). It was never actually changed in patch 25.16 beyond the tooltip.

entries.subject: Taliyah
entries.context: Taliyah is one of a handful of mage junglers, and we think she can be better supported for meta diversity. We’re buffing her [E] Unraveled Earth damage to make it more satisfying to land her CC combo.

changes.text: Monster Damage: Deals 225% damage to monsters.
changes.label: Monster Damage

entries.subject: Taric
entries.context: We're smoothing out some of the rough edges in Taric’s kit to allow him to shine a bit more. Way back in the day, Taric’s W was adjusted to combat the popular Master Yi + Taric funnel strats. A consequence of this was that his spells would fizzle if they were cast at the same time that his bound ally became untargetable. We believe this harsh restriction to how his abilities function is no longer necessary given the existence of Role Quests, so we're partially reverting this change so that spells now work on untargetable allies, though we are still keeping an existing exemption on [E] Dazzle for champions that disappear on screen because the gameplay is too unclear (sorry, Master Yi).

changes.text: Cast Behavior: Q casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.
changes.label: Cast Behavior
changes.value: Q casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.

changes.text: Cast Behavior: E casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.
changes.label: Cast Behavior
changes.value: E casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.

changes.text: Tooltip: Updated to include “Dazzle will not cast from Vanished allies”.
changes.label: Tooltip
changes.value: Updated to include “Dazzle will not cast from Vanished allies”.

changes.text: Cast Behavior: R casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.
changes.label: Cast Behavior
changes.value: R casts when allies are untargetable will now successfully fire.

entries.subject: Tristana
entries.context: Tristana’s early laning has devolved a bit into "Level 1 press [Q] and just auto attack to take complete control of the lane", which is a pretty low gameplay and off flavor way for her to succeed. We’re hitting her early [Q] attack speed so she’ll have to work a bit harder before jumping on her foes.

entries.subject: Twisted Fate
entries.context: Alongside the Taric QoL changes, we’re giving Twisted Fate’s R the same treatment so he can reveal champs even if they’re untargetable at the time of activation.

entries.subject: Varus
entries.context: In this set of changes, we’re mainly looking to snipe top lane Varus, where he tends to max W, unlike the more common Q max in bot. This won't bring his [Q] Piercing Arrow back up to prior Lethality Varus levels of power, but we believe it will help a lot with our ability to tune him for bot lane. As a maxed ability, it also offers more gameplay to Varus and his opponents to interact with than some more passive damage on W.

changes.text: Damage Calculation: Max Damage scaling, 53.33 - 240 (+80% bonus AD) to 80 - 360 (+120% bonus AD) ⇒ Min Damage scaling, 50 - 230 (+80% bonus AD) to 85 - 391 (+136% bonus AD)
changes.label: Damage Calculation
changes.before: Max Damage scaling, 53.33 - 240 (+80% bonus AD) to 80 - 360 (+120% bonus AD)
changes.after: Min Damage scaling, 50 - 230 (+80% bonus AD) to 85 - 391 (+136% bonus AD)

changes.label: Damage Increase over Channel Time

changes.text: Per Stack Damage: 3 - 5% (+1.3% per 100 AP) Target Maximum Health ⇒ 2.5 - 4.5% (+1.4% per 100 AP) Target Maximum Health
changes.label: Per Stack Damage

changes.label: Active Missing Health Damage
changes.before: 6 - 14%, increased by up to 50% based on Q Channel
changes.after: 6 - 10%, increased by up to 70% based on Q Channel

changes.label: Basic Ability Cooldown Refund
changes.before: 13% per stack, increased by up to 50% based on Q Channel
changes.after: 11%, increased by up to 70% based on Q Channel

entries.subject: Vel'Koz
entries.context: Vel’Koz has been a fairly quiet pick this year, having little presence or meta impact in mid and support. We’re looking to give him a little bit of help by rewarding him for landing his combos.

entries.subject: Viktor
entries.context: It’s time for the Glorious…Devolution. It seems Viktor has evolved past the point of exploitable weaknesses, so we’re opening that up a bit by making him slightly more vulnerable in early game skirmishes and across the board.

entries.subject: Wukong
entries.context: Like Lee and Qiyana, Wukong has been a meta staple whirlwind of a force in the jungle for a while now. We’re looking to tap down his strength in the jungle while compensating for lane Wukong.

changes.text: Armor per Stack: 6 - 10 (based on Champion Level) ⇒ 4.5 - 10 (based on Champion Level)
changes.label: Armor per Stack

entries.subject: Xin Zhao
entries.context: Following Sundered Sky's nerfs, we feel like Xin Zhao has room for buffs to both his AD Bruiser and AS focused builds, so we’re helping out his scalings.

changes.text: Damage per Strike: 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 (+40% bonus AD) ⇒ 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 (+45% bonus AD)
changes.label: Damage per Strike

changes.text: Attack Speed Scaling: 1% per 5% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources ⇒ 1% per 4% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources
changes.label: Attack Speed Scaling
changes.before: 1% per 5% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources
changes.after: 1% per 4% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources

entries.subject: Yone
entries.context: The last changes to Yone successfully got him to start considering crit in his first item purchases, but also put him at a somewhat unsustainable power level. We are giving him a moderate nerf to bring him down a bit.

entries.subject: Zyra
entries.context: Like Vel'koz, Zyra has had relatively little impact in the meta as tanks and enchanter supports have reigned supreme. We’re giving Zyra a greener thumb this patch to help her combat the forces trampling over her plants.

entries.subject: Bastion Breaker
entries.context: Bastion Breaker was buffed into being a bit of a generic stat stick in order to give it a proper swing in the meta. Now, we’re nerfing that generic power with a QoL improvement to keep it a satisfying item in its niche.

changes.text: Shaped Charge Damage: 50 Melee + 1.5/Lethality / 25 Ranged + 0.75/Lethality ⇒ 40 Melee + 1.5/Lethality / 20 Ranged + 0.75/Lethality
changes.label: Shaped Charge Damage

changes.text: Sabotage Duration Context: This is how long you have to use the bonus damage against objectives.
changes.label: Sabotage Duration Context
changes.value: This is how long you have to use the bonus damage against objectives.

entries.subject: Dawncore
entries.context: Dawncore is the enchanter capstone that isn’t, and currently only Soraka picks it up. Even when other supports get to full build, they often prefer other purchases. We’re buffing its AP value to make it less purely bound to Healing and Shielding.

changes.text: Ability Power per 100% Base Mana Regeneration: 10 ⇒ 15
changes.label: Ability Power per 100% Base Mana Regeneration

entries.subject: Gluttonous Greaves
entries.context: The greaves are overperforming for marksmen, even when getting very few stacks, so we’re hitting it with a nerf to its cost to delay early acquisitions from getting too much value.

entries.subject: Hubris
entries.context: While Hubris has been a bit weak for melee champions, it’s clearly been overperforming for ranged users. We’re delineating between the two now to encourage melees and disincentivize ranged users from building it.

changes.text: Base Bonus Attack Damage: 12 ⇒ 15 Melee / 10 Ranged
changes.label: Base Bonus Attack Damage

changes.text: Bonus Attack Damage per Stack: 3 ⇒ 3 Melee / 2 Ranged
changes.label: Bonus Attack Damage per Stack

changes.text: Fixed an issue where Zaahen (Q) would fail to complete if he does into Revive mid attack.
Fixed a bug where Titanic Hydra’s cooldown timer would not be displayed after use.
Fixed a bug where Zoe can get a 1000 damage smite from a minion drop earlier than expected.
Fixed a bug where Hail of Blades does not trigger on auto resets if the first attack was cancelled.
Fixed a bug where Nidalee’s (Q) spear damage could go through spell shields at max range.

entries.subject: Ambessa
entries.context: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.

entries.subject: Ashe
entries.context: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.

entries.subject: Cassiopeia
entries.context: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros. We're taking another swing at her early resources because of how dominant she still is in early laning, making her work a little harder to create an advantage.

entries.subject: Diana
entries.context: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind. We want to inject a bit more power into that playstyle.

entries.subject: Kennen
entries.context: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.

entries.subject: Kindred
entries.context: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades. Optimistically, they'd also make a pretty unique addition to the meta.

entries.subject: K'Sante
entries.context: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.

entries.subject: Lillia
entries.context: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for. We believe there is a bit more room for her to really prance around various levels of play so we are following up with another buff that'll really help her shine.

entries.subject: Lucian
entries.context: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.

entries.subject: Mordekaiser
entries.context: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition. His bread and butter (Q) can also feel less impactful as the pace of the game increases, so we think it can do more damage later on.

entries.subject: Neeko
entries.context: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation

entries.subject: Smolder
entries.context: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly. We're further encouraging crit builds to bring his bruiser and full crit builds closer in power.

changes.text: Super Scorcher Bonus Magic Damage: 25 - 55% (+0-9% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance ⇒ 25 - 60% (+0-10.5% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
changes.label: Super Scorcher Bonus Magic Damage
changes.before: 25 - 55% (+0-9% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
changes.after: 25 - 60% (+0-10.5% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance

changes.label: Flap Flap Flap Bonus Magic Damage
changes.before: 8 - 12.8% (+0-1.44% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance
changes.after: 8 - 14% (+0-1.8% with IE) of Dragon Practice Stacks, scaling with Crit Chance

entries.subject: Swain
entries.context: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.

entries.subject: Tahm Kench
entries.context: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item. We're giving him compensation for that.

entries.subject: Vayne
entries.context: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer. We're adjusting her base stats to help in bot where she needs to weather harass, and reverting a mana cost to her Q that simply felt way too bad.

entries.subject: Yunara
entries.context: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.

changes.text: Slow Stacking: Stacks with other slows ⇒ No longer stacks with other slows
changes.label: Slow Stacking
changes.after: No longer stacks with other slows

entries.subject: Experimental Hexplate
entries.context: We've been fairly unhappy with how this item has played out for ranged users, especially as a first rush in top lane where it makes them too resilient to burst and too lethal during all ins.

changes.text: Ranged Mod: 70% of Value (35% Attack Speed, 14% Move Speed) ⇒ 50% of Value (25% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed)
changes.label: Ranged Mod
changes.before: 70% of Value (35% Attack Speed, 14% Move Speed)
changes.after: 50% of Value (25% Attack Speed, 10% Move Speed)

entries.subject: Hextech Rocketbelt
entries.context: Rocketbelt continues to be used a bit too much as an escape compared to a risky engage tool, so we are pulling back on its generic value in favor of emphasizing aggressive action with it, especially for AP Bruisers who rely on it for all ins.

entries.subject: Runaan's Hurricane
entries.context: This item was slightly overbuffed, so pulling back on that a bit.

changes.text: Fixed a bug where Orianna's (R) VFX and actual hitbox become misplaced if she casts (R) before the ball reaches a fast-moving ally like Nocturne.
Fixed a bug where a Sylas-stolen Depth Charge (R) from Nautilus could fizzle after Sylas lost vision of the target.
Fixed a bug where Xin Zhao's Three Talon Strike (Q) went completely on cooldown if the first attack was dodged by spells like Shen's Shadow Dash (E) or Jax's Counterstrike (E).
Fixed a bug where Shyvana's Dragon's Descent (R) ability fails to cancel enemy teleports.
Fixed a bug where Kayle's Reckoning (Q) applies the on-hit Spellblade effect from Sheen, Lich Bane, Trinity Force, and Iceborne Gauntlet.
Fixed a bug where Sivir's Spell Shield (E) does not block Leona's Zenith Blade (E).
Fixed a bug where Malphite's Flash summoner spell is disabled after using Unstoppable Force (R).
Fixed a bug where rapidly pressing Recall gains Guinsoo's Rageblade stacks.
Fixed a bug where Runaan's Hurricane Volley (P) triggers Minions' Call for Help.
Fixed a bug where Sivir's Spell Shield does not block damage from Miss Fortune's Q.

entries.subject: Aatrox
entries.context: We think The Darkin Blade has lost a fair bit of power with Sundered Sky nerfs that were aimed more at opening up the jungle meta, so we are giving him a bump so he remains a world-ending threat.

changes.text: Health Heal Ratio: 1.1% per 100 bonus health ⇒ 1.3% per 100 bonus health
changes.label: Health Heal Ratio

entries.subject: Aphelios
entries.context: Aphelios has been kiting the spotlight for a while now, even though he's a hypercarry in an enchanter meta that should favor him, so we're looking to give him a little boost to encourage him to get out of his comfort zone.

changes.text: Moonshot Damage: 70 - 160 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP) ⇒ 80 - 170 (+42 - 60% bonus AD) (+100% AP)
changes.label: Moonshot Damage

changes.label: Slow

changes.after: 30% for 2.5 seconds, decaying to 15% after 0.7 seconds

changes.label: Mini-Crescendum Damage
changes.before: 15% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 8th+ chakram
changes.after: 16% AD, decreasing by 1.5% AD to a minimum of 5% AD for the 9th+ chakram

entries.subject: Aurora
entries.context: Despite not receiving any changes since last year, Aurora has fallen off as we've had to nerf Rocketbelt into a fairer state. We're giving our favorite Bryni a bit more power in her waveclear and outplay potential with her ultimate.

entries.subject: Draven
entries.context: Since all bot laners received significantly increased gold income thanks to role quests, Draven's potential to gain a gold advantage through his Adoration stacks has lost some of its impact. We're giving him a helping hand (axe?) by tapping up his early game damage.

entries.subject: Elise
entries.context: This year started strong for AP junglers that could use Dusk and Dawn, but others like Elise have been in a weak spot for a while, so we are helping out our friendly neighborhood spider with clear speed and damage.

entries.subject: Fiora
entries.context: Our Grand Duelist has room to shine a bit more when she succeeds after finding her opening, without giving her sharper 1v1 tools.

entries.subject: Kha'Zix
entries.context: Kha'Zix has been on the fringe of the meta now that the jungle is no longer dominated by Sundered Sky users. We are taking this opportunity to buff some of his weaker evolves to give him the flexibility to adapt and overcome.

entries.subject: Lillia
entries.context: Lillia is on the edge of being viable at higher levels of play and we believe her current pattern requires her to get in danger's way, so we're helping her durability. We also want to give Lillia opportunities to really be a playmaker so we're making the enemies she lullabies a little extra sleepy.

entries.subject: Lucian
entries.context: Years ago, we added the Vigilance Passive so Lucian bot players didn't feel like their champ was being nerfed because of mid laners, which ended up being super effective. We think now is a good opportunity to adjust the tuning of the passive and strike a balance between both roles.

entries.subject: Master Yi
entries.context: Somewhat overdue, but because Duskblade was removed a while ago, we're removing the Ability Haste penalty we had to apply to his Q CDR mechanic. This should have minimal impact on Summoner's Rift, but we see you Mayhem and Arena!

changes.text: Cooldown Refund on Hit: -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste ⇒ 1 second
changes.label: Cooldown Refund on Hit
changes.before: -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste

entries.subject: Nasus
entries.context: Nasus is difficult to keep down these days, and part of that is how quickly getting his early stacks leads to more reliable stacking. These higher highs will be compensated with some lower lows through some more vulnerability early on with lower damage and lifesteal lane sustain values off of that, and a bit longer before he really comes online.

entries.subject: Nocturne
entries.context: Nocturne has been a popular and powerful jungler in both pro and solo-queue for a while, so we're hitting the map presence and dueling power he benefits from through his ultimate.

entries.subject: Poppy
entries.context: Poppy's flex potential and jungle presence has been a bit problematic, suppressing many champions across the board as a strong counterpick. For this change, we're targeting her flexibility by reverting a previous buff to jungle clear.

entries.subject: Rumble
entries.context: At higher levels of play, we've seen Rumble continue to take over games, even after our changes earlier this year designed to hit his power in lane. Here, we're making some modifications to his passive that's much more elite-skewed, while giving Rumble in the Jungle some compensation.

entries.subject: Ryze
entries.context: Between strong itemization options and best-in-class skirmish and roam potential demonstrated by his most skilled players, it's high time we put some restraints on the archmage, while giving him some help with bad solo queue matchups.

changes.text: Flux Bonus Damage: 25 / 50 / 75 / 100% increased damage ⇒ 15 / 40 / 65 / 90% increased damage
changes.label: Flux Bonus Damage

entries.subject: Vi
entries.context: Vi has been a meta staple for the entire year, and now that Sundered Sky is in a better spot, we're going after her durability and early clear speed to make her a riskier pick who can still bring the pain if you are willing to build for it.

entries.subject: Volibear
entries.context: This year we've been carefully buffing up AD Volibear, but he remains on the weak side even with his very unique AP build. We're tuning him up to help him out across both the fringe AD build and his core AP build.

changes.text: Attack Speed per Stack: 5% (+3% per 100 AP) ⇒ 5% (+4% per 100 AP)
changes.label: Attack Speed per Stack

changes.text: Lightning On-Hit Damage: 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) ⇒ 11 - 60 (Levels 1-18) (+45% AP) (+20% bonus AD)
changes.label: Lightning On-Hit Damage

entries.subject: World Atlas and Runic Compass
entries.context: We think melee supports have too much of their power in roaming and all-ins and are too weak in sustained laning. In response, we're shifting the flat health to health regen on World Atlas and Runic Compass, which will benefit them more due to their higher base health regen values.

entries.subject: Teleport Cooldown
entries.context: As the meta has continued to adjust to role quests, it's become clear that top lane is slightly weak, especially for split pushing. We're in turn buffing the cooldown of both the free role quest Teleport and upgraded Unleashed Teleport to promote those alternative strategies.

changes.text: Top Role Quest's Free Teleport Cooldown: 420 seconds ⇒ 390 seconds
changes.label: Top Role Quest's Free Teleport Cooldown

changes.text: Top Role Quest's Upgraded Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds ⇒ 300 - 210 seconds
changes.label: Top Role Quest's Upgraded Unleashed Teleport Cooldown

changes.text: Non-Top Unleashed Teleport Cooldown: 330 - 240 seconds ⇒ Unchanged
changes.label: Non-Top Unleashed Teleport Cooldown

changes.text: Fixed a bug where Renata's R would not amp damage caused by Berserk targets.
Fixed a bug where Taliyah's W terrain was smaller than the hitbox.
Fixed a bug where Yunara's auto resets would not extend Hail of Blades appropriately.
Fixed a bug where Renekton would not gain 20 fury from his ult when it was cast immediately after W.
Fixed a bug where clones would not receive Homeguards after running back to the fountain
Fixed a bug where Camille's W would count as two hits when triggering bone plating.
Fixed a bug where Camille's Passive would sometimes not proc Shield Bash.
Fixed a bug where Aatrox Q sweetspots use crit text instead of enhanced damage text.

entries.subject: Bard
entries.context: Bard has been a meta staple for much of the year. Earlier we toned his damage down to what we think are reasonable levels, so this time we are going to target his durability which has also stood out as high given his mobility and long range ultimate utility.

entries.subject: Cassiopeia
entries.context: Cassio has always scaled with skill, but this year has propelled her to new heights of pro play dominance despite being weaker for average players. These adjustments should tap down her laning power, especially in pro where defensive purchases are valued more than raw AP, while giving her back some scaling power. It will still be critical to use empowered E's, but raising her floor lets us be a bit more flexible with tuning.

changes.text: Move Speed Bonus: 6% - 40% (based on level) ⇒ 5% - 36% (based on level)
changes.label: Move Speed Bonus

entries.subject: Ekko
entries.context: As one of our assassins that offer opponents a wider mix of gameplay options, Ekko has found a slightly weak steady state since Dusk & Dawn's update mid year. We believe he has some room for power, especially in mid where he scales slightly worse, without buffing his Hail of Blades pattern.

entries.subject: Kassadin
entries.context: Kassadin had a strong start to 2026 but hasn't regained his…footing…since our earlier nerfs. His Q should feel more punchy with his scaling, and we're aiming to provide more early agency through good Riftwalk usage without touching his late game fantasy.

entries.subject: Master Yi
entries.context: Yi drew the short end of the stick on the Rageblade bugfix from earlier this year due to his double strike interactions. While the actual impact for most Rageblade users was minor (and we are compensating Rageblade as well for that this patch), he was impacted harder than the other users. He's also just been unable to scale as well as a melee carry compared to his normal power level, so we are also giving him a buff up.

entries.subject: Nautilus
entries.context: Nautilus has been sitting near the top of the meta for the entire year, even before our work to bring other tank supports up in power, and we feel nerfing him will open up room for a more variety. That said, we know a lot of his value is in being able to lock down champions effectively, and that'll remain a core strength.

entries.subject: Seraphine
entries.context: Seraphine bot has been a source of frustration for opponents for some time, despite a minor nerf a few patches ago. We are nerfing her E's rank up to target this head on, as support Seraphine usually maxes it last (which basically means she never has it maxed as a support.)

entries.subject: Syndra
entries.context: Our MSI changes were effective at pulling her to the forefront of pro play for the first time in years, but unfortunately she's too performant in specific solo queue settings. Our data shows that W damage is a meaningfully larger share of damage in the tiers where she's stronger than desired, so this should help tap her down while still preserving her core fantasies. Her passive is also now better breakpointed to increase reliance on Lost Chapter in early-mid levels, nerfing her higher winrate builds that make do with less mana investment.

entries.subject: Viego
entries.context: Viego's winrate has been on a downward trend recently, and his players have noticed and begun dropping him. He has a fair bit of room to bring up, both just generally and for the viability of his more bruisery alt build.

changes.text: Heal: 2% (+…. ) ⇒ 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) (+ 2% per 500 bonus HP) of the target's maximum health
changes.label: Heal
changes.after: 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) (+ 2% per 500 bonus HP) of the target's maximum health

entries.subject: Zaahen
entries.context: We're using a QoL change here as an opportunity to give Zaahen some love! This might read as a nerf, but Zaahen's Q lined up with his passive in such a way that it meant he always left his resurrection (and GA, Zilean R) with Q on CD, so now he's always happier. His Q2 is also a clean double of his Q1 base damage now.

changes.text: Cooldown Behavior: If Q is active, it is now placed on Cooldown immediately upon being put in Resurrection
changes.label: Cooldown Behavior
changes.value: If Q is active, it is now placed on Cooldown immediately upon being put in Resurrection

entries.subject: Zeri
entries.context: Zeri has been slowly climbing in winrate with the recent Runaan's Hurricane and Yun Tal Wildarrows buffs. She now sits very high in winrate compared to her historical resting, which is worrying for a champ that is so skill intensive. As she has also begun showing up in pro, we expect she has a high chance of becoming meta dominant, so we are pulling some power out of her burst and waveclear.

entries.subject: Guinsoo's Rageblade
entries.context: In light of the bugfix nerfing rageblade by a minor amount by pushing back when the first double hit triggers, we are compensating with a similarly minor QoL buff to help players get it stacked up and keep it stacked.

changes.text: Fixed a bug where Baron Nashor's max stacks of Void Corruption was higher than intended.
Fixed a bug where Serpent's Fang's Shield Reaver damage applied Omnivamp.

entries.subject: Aurelion Sol
entries.context: Aurelion Sol has come out the loser of last patch's mage adjustments, so we are giving him a buff to help him out. In particular, we are buffing his W cooldown so he can use it a bit more freely rather than only when a reset is likely. This should also make it a bit more clear to players that W is typically the stronger second skill to max, rather than E. Q - Breath of Light

entries.subject: Cho'Gath
entries.context: Cho's early game has lost pizzazz with Hail of Blades and Hextech Rocketbelt nerfs, so we are making it up with a bit of early damage when he does get those autos off.

changes.text: Base Damage (x3 attacks): 20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+30% AP) (+2.5% - 3.9% (+.5% Per Feast) Target Max HP) ⇒ 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+30% AP) (+2.5% - 3.9% (+.5% Per Feast) Target Max HP)
changes.label: Base Damage (x3 attacks)

entries.subject: Graves
entries.context: Graves has had a number of indirect buffs over the last few patches and this has put him in a pretty strong spot. We are looking to soften a bit of his ability to snowball the game with high AD builds. Q - End of the Line

entries.subject: Irelia
entries.context:
Irelia is one of League’s highest stakes snowballing dependant skirmishers, but we feel like even when ahead she is failing to scale into a real carry threat

Additionally, we are buffing some of her AP ratios to support wacky ARAM/Arena builds. We don’t expect this to make AP Irelia suddenly good for SR.

changes.text: Damage Reduction Ability Power Ratio: 7% per 100 AP (Halved for Magic Damage) (reduced to 75% value for Magic Damage in Arena) ⇒ 8% per 100 AP (Halved for Magic Damage) (reduced to 75% value for Magic Damage in Arena)
changes.label: Damage Reduction Ability Power Ratio
changes.before: 7% per 100 AP (Halved for Magic Damage) (reduced to 75% value for Magic Damage in Arena)
changes.after: 8% per 100 AP (Halved for Magic Damage) (reduced to 75% value for Magic Damage in Arena)

changes.text: Ability Power Ratio: 70% ⇒ 100% (It is already 100% in Arena, so this is standardizing the value)
changes.label: Ability Power Ratio
changes.after: 100% (It is already 100% in Arena, so this is standardizing the value)

entries.subject: LeBlanc
entries.context: With the previous version of Statikk Shiv that drove nerfing her AS ratios no longer in the game, we’re bringing these closer to a typical champion’s baseline. Simultaneously, having some room for power, we are giving her some AP ratio buffs to make sure she's still interested primarily in AP assassination builds.

entries.subject: Nasus
entries.context: Nasus top has been able to benefit from the shift in his stacking paradigm. We are happy to see our favorite dog get his fill of treats, but want to make sure that we keep his power within reasonable bounds, therefore we are going to be tapping down some of Nasus' top specific strengths, like persistently lifestealing off of minions.

entries.subject: Nocturne
entries.context: Nocturne has been sitting in a pretty strong state across skill levels for a while. We are excited about the opportunities that open up when Nocturne unlocks his ult, but want to add a bit more personal risk to him accessing that high moment.

entries.subject: Qiyana
entries.context: Qiyana's play has moved out of primarily mid to jungle. While we are happy to support her as a jungler, mid is where she’s been underwhelming recently .

changes.text: Monster Damage Modifier: 175% against Monsters ⇒ 160% against Monsters
changes.label: Monster Damage Modifier

entries.subject: Thresh
entries.context: Thresh has been quietly sitting at a high winrate and picking up playrate over the year.

entries.subject: Trundle
entries.context: Sometimes you just wanna club your opponents to death, and while Trundle has been a resilient utility pick for his pillar and ult, we feel his personal clubbing power has actually been a bit limp.

entries.subject: Vayne
entries.context: We believe Vayne may need larger scope work in the future to help out her bot lane, but for now are prioritizing constraining her top lane power. These changes should impact her up there more than in bot lane.

changes.text: True Damage: 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10% Target Max HP ⇒ 4 / 5.5 / 7 / 8.5 / 10% Target Max HP
changes.label: True Damage

entries.subject: Xerath
entries.context: Xerath has rested slightly high in power both mid and bot, and after last patch's adjustments to mages has come out on top in mid lane compared to others. Given his extremely high ban rate in certain regions, he's due a light nerf.

entries.subject: Yasuo
entries.context: While Yasuo has definitely been able to snowball and carry games, we believe that similar to Irelia, he is too reliant on snowballing rather than just being a proper scaling carry. We also want to encourage him to prioritize early crit strike builds over Blade of the Ruined King, so we are reducing his crit damage penalty which will simultaneously encourage this as well help him scale without significantly impacting his early game snowball.

entries.subject: Yone
entries.context: Similar to Yasuo, Yone has also been an excessively snowball reliant carry, though less so. Bros stay together.

entries.subject: Stormrazor
entries.context: Stormrazor almost had its time in the sun earlier this year, but has ended up remaining second fiddle.

entries.subject: Sundered Sky
entries.context: Last patch’s Sundered Sky nerf was a step in the right direction, but landed a bit under-target given all of the other moving pieces of that patch.

changes.text: Fixed a bug where Jayce's EQ damage was not properly displayed as enhanced damage.
Fixed a bug where Diana's E dash speed was slower than intended in certain cases.
Fixed a bug where Akali's Shuriken (E) could travel across the map, allowing her to hit and dash to targets at unintended distances.
Fixed a bug where Vladimir P would not properly convert AP from runes.
Fixed a bug in Blind Pick (Custom Games) where junglers would be locked out of their starting items in very rare cases.

entries.subject: Azir
entries.context: We are continuing to monitor Azir, especially as players continue to pick up Press The Attack as his optimal keystone. For now however, we are going to give him a moderate buff to his laning to help him out.

entries.subject: Bel'Veth
entries.context: Bel'Veth has come out with the scaling curve of Kayle and Aurelion Sol. Her power is rapidly growing across all skill brackets and given her early game is already quite weak, we've opted to make her late game a bit less sharp.

changes.text: True Form Remora Indicator: Resource bar now turns purple when True Form can spawn Remora
changes.label: True Form Remora Indicator
changes.value: Resource bar now turns purple when True Form can spawn Remora

entries.subject: Camille
entries.context: With roaming supports all the rage, Camille has been queen. We are simultaneously looking to nerf her support roaming power while keeping or (hopefully) actually buffing her top lane. This means trading the raw all in power behind her passive shield early game in favor of significantly lowered cooldowns for better repeatable trading.

changes.text: Outer Cone Bonus Damage: 6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8% (+2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) Target Maximum Health ⇒ 7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9% (+2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) Target Maximum Health
changes.label: Outer Cone Bonus Damage
changes.before: 6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8% (+2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) Target Maximum Health
changes.after: 7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9% (+2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) Target Maximum Health

entries.subject: Gwen
entries.context: Gwen has remained slightly weak since her nerfs earlier this year. We are buffing her passive sustain back up towards where it has previously been, which should help her be a powerful threat in some of her stronger matchups without making her feel uncounterable.

changes.text: Healing On Champions: 50% post-mitigation, capped to 10-25 (based on level) (+6.5% AP) ⇒ 67% post-mitigation, capped to 12-40 (based on level) (+7% AP)
changes.label: Healing On Champions
changes.before: 50% post-mitigation, capped to 10-25 (based on level) (+6.5% AP)
changes.after: 67% post-mitigation, capped to 12-40 (based on level) (+7% AP)

entries.subject: Kennen
entries.context: With the reshape to Hextech Rocketbelt to prevent it from becoming the ubiquitous mage legendary, Kennen came out behind the pack. We are buffing him to compensate, making sure he is rewarded well when he does find the right flanks for those huge team-deleting ults.

entries.subject: Nasus
entries.context: Nasus has been a distinct jungle pick that we think is pretty exciting to see; however his top lane has lagged very far behind. We are adjusting his Q stack generation to bring these two roles closer to each other in raw power.

changes.text: Stacks: 3, increased to 12 on champions / large minions / monsters ⇒ 4, increased to 10 on champions / large minions / monsters
changes.label: Stacks
changes.before: 3, increased to 12 on champions / large minions / monsters
changes.after: 4, increased to 10 on champions / large minions / monsters

entries.subject: Poppy
entries.context: Poppy is meant to be a tank whose gameplay has leaned too far into early game snowball fighter, to the point she's choosing Hail of Blades and Sundered Sky over more tank runes and items. We're looking to shift power out of her early game AD fighter pattern and enable her tank pattern by significantly increasing her scaling with durability and giving her enough mana growth that sustained combat doesn't immediately run her out of resources.

changes.text: Damage: 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 (+100% bonus Attack Damage) (+9% Target Maximum Health), twice ⇒ 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 (+75% bonus Attack Damage) (+7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9% Target Maximum Health), twice
changes.label: Damage
changes.before: 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 (+100% bonus Attack Damage) (+9% Target Maximum Health), twice
changes.after: 30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 (+75% bonus Attack Damage) (+7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9% Target Maximum Health), twice

changes.text: Total Armor and Magic Resistance: 12%, doubled below 40% Maximum Health ⇒ 16%, doubled below 40% Maximum Health
changes.label: Total Armor and Magic Resistance

entries.subject: Berserker's Greaves
entries.context: Berserker's Greaves have been sitting at a particularly low state of power for a while now, and with the state of AD champions in both bot and mid, we feel this is the right time to buff them.

entries.subject: Black Cleaver
entries.context: Black Cleaver has become a Smolder / Senna item more than a core AD fighter item. We are re-adding the Melee / Ranged split on the move speed effect to buy space to buff it for AD fighters without pushing it over the top for its ranged user base.

changes.text: Fervor Move Speed: 20 for 2s ⇒ [20 Melee || 10 Ranged] for 2s
changes.label: Fervor Move Speed

entries.subject: Eclipse
entries.context: Eclipse has similarly fallen behind as an option for AD champions as a high ticket early AD item that isn't in the Lethality space. We feel it has clear space for a buff.

changes.text: Damage: [6% Melee || 4% Ranged] Target Maximum Health ⇒ [8% Melee || 5% Ranged] Target Maximum Health
changes.label: Damage

changes.text: Shield: [160 + 40% bonus Attack Damage Melee || 80 + 20% bonus Attack Damage Ranged] ⇒ [150 + 40% bonus Attack Damage Melee || 75 + 20% bonus Attack Damage Ranged]
changes.label: Shield
changes.before: [160 + 40% bonus Attack Damage Melee || 80 + 20% bonus Attack Damage Ranged]
changes.after: [150 + 40% bonus Attack Damage Melee || 75 + 20% bonus Attack Damage Ranged]

entries.subject: Runaan's Hurricane
entries.context: Runaan's Hurricane has lost all of its core users over the course of the year as ADCs have moved to a wider variety of AS Crit itemization. We are buffing its unique effect and movespeed to help players capitalize on the positioning requirements of that unique effect.

changes.text: Wind's Fury Bolt Damage: 55% Attack Damage ⇒ 65% Attack Damage
changes.label: Wind's Fury Bolt Damage

entries.subject: Sterak's Gage
entries.context: Sterak's Gage has also lost its position as the premium juggernaut / diver teamfight item, with Guardian Angel taking its place. We think Sterak's is a much healthier fit for these champions to take.

changes.text: Bonus Attack Damage: 45% of Base Attack Damage ⇒ 50% of Base Attack Damage
changes.label: Bonus Attack Damage

entries.subject: Sundered Sky
entries.context: Sundered Sky, on the other hand, has been the meta dominant AD fighter item for the last year. While we do find it exciting to see when players manage to chain its triggers through a teamfight and barely survive risky engages, we think it's a bit too performant when optimized to the point where it's healing for more than even lifesteal based items.

changes.text: Recipe: Tunneler (1150g) + Caulfield's (1050g) + Ruby Crystal (400g) + 500g ⇒ Tunneler (1150g) + Caulfield's (1050g) + 900g
changes.label: Recipe

changes.text: Healing: [100% Melee || 50% Ranged] Base Attack Damage + 6% Missing Health ⇒ [90% Melee || 45% Ranged] Base Attack Damage + 4% Missing Health
changes.label: Healing
changes.before: [100% Melee || 50% Ranged] Base Attack Damage + 6% Missing Health
changes.after: [90% Melee || 45% Ranged] Base Attack Damage + 4% Missing Health

entries.subject: Sunfire Cape
entries.context: Sunfire Cape has remained a powerful item in League, both in purchase and winrate, but players have repeatedly called out dissatisfaction with the item because of how directly it's compared against Hollow Radiance. We are upping its cost to match Hollow Radiance and shifting its power towards PvP damage to give the item more comparable advantages.

changes.text: Minion / Monster Modifier: 160% Minion, 200% Monster ⇒ 150% Minion, 180% Monster
changes.label: Minion / Monster Modifier

entries.subject: Chainlaced Crushers
entries.context: We continue to feel that defensive boot optimizations in mid lane stifle action. Since we are looking to shift mage power back from bot lane to mid lane this patch, we are also taking the time to nerf down mid lane counter itemization against mages.

entries.subject: Spellslinger's Shoes
entries.context: Along with Chainlaced Crushers' change, we are buffing Spellslinger's Shoes to further affect mid vs bot mage balance.

entries.subject: Tiamat
entries.context: Tiamat has ended up in a state where even if you are buying a Hydra item, it's optimal NOT to purchase it until you have all the other components. That's pretty lame, yo.

entries.subject: Fleet Footwork
entries.context: Fleet Footwork has been a relatively weaker and underutilized Precision keystone, and we feel like it has room to be a decent option for sustaining against harass past early laning and onwards.

changes.text: Healing: 10-130 ( +[10% bonus AD Melee || 6% bonus AD Ranged]) ( +[5% AP Melee || 3% AP Ranged]) ⇒ 15-160 ( +[10% bonus AD Melee || 6% bonus AD Ranged]) ( +[5% AP Melee || 3% AP Ranged])
changes.label: Healing
changes.before: 10-130 ( +[10% bonus AD Melee || 6% bonus AD Ranged]) ( +[5% AP Melee || 3% AP Ranged])
changes.after: 15-160 ( +[10% bonus AD Melee || 6% bonus AD Ranged]) ( +[5% AP Melee || 3% AP Ranged])

entries.subject: Hail of Blades
entries.context: Hail of Blades is currently contributing significantly to the extreme early game roaming meta with its super front loaded power skew. We are pushing its power back towards scaling to help soften this impact.

changes.text: Attack Speed: 120% Melee || 60% Ranged ⇒ 90% Melee || 60% Ranged
changes.label: Attack Speed

changes.text: Bonus True Damage: 4-20 (+8% bonus AD) (+6% AP) ⇒ 2-20 (+12% bonus AD) (+10% AP)
changes.label: Bonus True Damage

entries.subject: ADC MAGIC RESISTANCE
entries.context: Finally, next to the changes to boot rewards in midlane, we are also adjusting MR for all ADC champions to help them out against mages early game. We also hope this will help a few of them in mid lane, where we believe a healthier pool of AD champions (including potentially Akshan and Tristana) will also help create a more diverse jungle meta beyond AD fighters.

changes.text: Affected Champions: Akshan, Aphelios, Ashe, Caitlyn, Corki, Draven, Ezreal, Graves, Jhin, Jinx, Kai'Sa, Kalista, Kindred, Kog'Maw, Lucian, Miss Fortune, Quinn, Samira, Senna, Sivir, Smolder, Twitch, Varus, Vayne, Xayah, Yunara, Zeri
changes.label: Affected Champions
changes.value: Akshan, Aphelios, Ashe, Caitlyn, Corki, Draven, Ezreal, Graves, Jhin, Jinx, Kai'Sa, Kalista, Kindred, Kog'Maw, Lucian, Miss Fortune, Quinn, Samira, Senna, Sivir, Smolder, Twitch, Varus, Vayne, Xayah, Yunara, Zeri

entries.subject: JUNGLE PETS
entries.context: Speaking of a more diverse jungle Meta, we are adjusting the way jungle pets scales to help mage and tank junglers against the current AD fighter meta.

changes.text: Damage Per Attack: 20 - 150 (based on level) (+10% bonus Attack Damage) (+12% Ability Power) (+20% bonus Armor) (+20% bonus Magic Resistance) (+3% bonus Health) ⇒ 20 - 150 (based on level) (+10% bonus Attack Damage) (+16% Ability Power) (+25% bonus Armor) (+25% bonus Magic Resistance) (+4% bonus Health)
changes.label: Damage Per Attack
changes.before: 20 - 150 (based on level) (+10% bonus Attack Damage) (+12% Ability Power) (+20% bonus Armor) (+20% bonus Magic Resistance) (+3% bonus Health)
changes.after: 20 - 150 (based on level) (+10% bonus Attack Damage) (+16% Ability Power) (+25% bonus Armor) (+25% bonus Magic Resistance) (+4% bonus Health)

entries.subject: SUPPORT ROLE QUEST
entries.context: Finally, we are adjusting Support Role Quest progress to penalize heavy early game roaming by increasing the penalty while outside of bot lane, and removing the bonus progress gained from champion combat over minion last hitting.

changes.text: Stack Consumption On Champion / Turret Damage: 22 Melee || 20 Ranged and 24 Melee || 22 Ranged ⇒ 18 and 21
changes.label: Stack Consumption On Champion / Turret Damage

changes.text: Stack Consumption On Creep Score: 15 and 20 ⇒ 18 and 21
changes.label: Stack Consumption On Creep Score

changes.text: Minion Creep Score Experience / Gold Penalty: -25% outside of bot lane until level 3 ⇒ -33% outside of bot lane until level 5
changes.label: Minion Creep Score Experience / Gold Penalty
changes.before: -25% outside of bot lane until level 3
changes.after: -33% outside of bot lane until level 5

changes.text: Fixed a bug where Viego with the Bot lane Role Quest would be able to steal his possessed target's boots.
Fixed a bug where upgrading from Hexdrinker to Maw of Malmortius did not reset the cooldown of the item.
Fixed a bug where Locke picking up his (R) artifact would refund based on its current cooldown instead of the total cooldown.
Fixed a bug where Support players' Control wards would be consumed when trying to place them while dead.
Fixed a bug where Ambessa's omnivamp would apply on turrets when driving Rift Herald into them.
Fixed a bug where Mordekaiser (R) improperly gains Ability Haste.
Fixed a bug where Bel'Veth's resource bar would incorrectly update if she hit 80 stacks while already in True Form.
Fixed a bug where Locke (R) execution would be considered a spell cast.
